output.summary: After being told they had POTS at an appointment, the user asked what it meant, whether long COVID caused it, and whether it could improve or damage their heart. They described pounding heart, dizziness, and spotty vision when standing, as well as crashes after exertion; the assistant explained POTS and discussed self-management, pacing, and ways to respond when symptoms occur. The user said they felt less panicked and understood that POTS did not mean their heart was broken.
